_notes: Houdini's deck is sheet 178 (CardIDs 17800-17829, its own FaceURL); the character card 17700 is a sheet of its own (177, 1x1) inside the same physical deck, so the catalog lists two images and CardIDs 17700-17829 while deck.identity holds only the playing cards' sheet. No other hero has CardIDs 177xx or 178xx, and no GUID of this file is used by another hero.

The Houdini miniature (3ec3d1) is a Custom_Assetbundle; the Custom_Model nicknamed 'Houdini' that carries MAX_VALUE 14 (fdb21e) is his life dial. Bess is a Custom_Token (a73e79); the Custom_Model nicknamed 'Bess' with MAX_VALUE 5 (ede1d4) is her dial.
